title: 2025 cost recovery — Alder Fabrication
instructions: Alder Fabrication, a calendar-year C corporation, placed the assets below in service in 2025. All were acquired after January 19, 2025. Compute each amount for Alder's 2025 Form 4562. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Assets placed in service in 2025
exhibits.content:
| Asset | MACRS class | Cost | Placed in service |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Production machinery | 7-year | 1,800,000 | March 10 |
| Office furniture | 7-year | 200,000 | August 4 |
| Delivery truck (not a passenger auto) | 5-year | 90,000 | May 20 |
| Warehouse (nonresidential real property) | 39-year | 1,040,000, including land of 260,000 | October 15 |

exhibits.title: Elections and data
exhibits.content:
- Elect **§179 of $500,000** on the production machinery.
- **Elect out of bonus** for all 7-year property; take bonus on the 5-year class.
- Taxable income from the active business before §179: $3,000,000.
- 2025 §179 limit $2,500,000; phase-out threshold $4,000,000.
- First-year MACRS rates (half-year): 5-year 20.00%; 7-year 14.29%. Nonresidential real property: straight-line over 39 years, mid-month convention.

rows.label: Percentage of 2025 depreciable personal property placed in service in the fourth quarter
rows.explanation: No personal property was placed in service in October–December (the warehouse is real property and is excluded), so **0%** and the half-year convention applies.

rows.label: §179 deduction
rows.explanation: Qualifying purchases 2,090,000 (the building isn't §179 property) are under the 4,000,000 threshold, and 500,000 is within the business income limit: **500,000**.

rows.label: MACRS depreciation on the production machinery
rows.explanation: (1,800,000 − 500,000 §179) × 14.29% = **185,770**. Bonus was elected out for 7-year property.

rows.label: MACRS depreciation on the office furniture
Bonus depreciation on the delivery truck
rows.explanation: 100% bonus for property acquired after January 19, 2025: **90,000**, leaving no basis for MACRS.
